parsed.name: EMR-20电磁场强度探头
parsed.description: EMR-20是一种用于测量电磁场强度的场强探头，可输出现场测得的场强数值。它通常用于电磁兼容测试、辐射环境监测以及实验室中的电磁场分布测量。
parsed.description_en: The EMR-20 is a field strength probe used to measure electromagnetic field intensity and report the measured field value. It is typically used for EMC testing, radiated environment monitoring, and laboratory measurements of electromagnetic field distribution.

actions.description: 初始化并配置场强探头。
actions.description_en: Initialize and configure the field strength probe.
Read back the field strength measurement data.
